title: Versatile Assets / Opens, Closes and Mobile Identity
slide_intent: Give a visual ingredient several transition roles so viewers recognize the brand across changes of format and content.
strategic_value: The same current and wordmark can connect Spectrum’s footage, end cards and phone identity.
demonstration: A 4.63-second composite compares two landscape panels at left and a phone mockup at right. Current lines, light and the logo alternate with lifestyle footage.
practical_value: Compare how an opener, a footage overlay and a phone identity preserve the same signature while using different compositions.

content_islands.name: Landscape comparisons
content_islands.spec: Stack two horizontal video panels at left, alternating logo fields and lifestyle footage.

content_islands.name: Phone identity
content_islands.spec: Place a tall phone at right on the white board and carry the same blue current and logo through its portrait screen.

ingredient.name: Connectivity current transition
ingredient.role: Connect moving imagery with the brand signature.
ingredient.application: Adapt the current into opens, closes, footage transitions and loopable versions, with or without the tagline according to the supplied asset.
ingredient.scope: This case-study composite illustrates variants; it is not the complete production delivery or a timing specification.
